title: Nature Is Coming Back — But Funding Must Grow Faster
title_zh: 自然正在回归——但资金必须更快增长
summary_zh: 联合国「生态系统恢复十年」过半之际，新报告显示约2.52亿公顷土地正在恢复，并已创造逾百万绿色就业；但年资金须从640亿美元增至近3000亿（逾四倍），淡水、海洋与海岸尤为落后。报告在亚美尼亚埃里温生物多样性COP17发布。本文适合积累环境、生物多样性与公共投资类雅思词汇。
paragraphs: Halfway through the UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration, a new global report brings rare good news: about 252 million hectares across 149 countries are now under restoration — an area roughly the size of Kazakhstan. The effort has already created more than one million green jobs. UNEP Executive Director Inger Andersen says the world is witnessing the makings of one of the largest movements for nature in recorded history.

The report, Nature's Comeback — Scaling Ecosystem Restoration for People and Planet, was launched at the COP17 biodiversity conference in Yerevan, Armenia. Governments still aim to restore around one billion hectares by 2030 and to place 30 per cent of ecosystems under conservation, as agreed in the 2022 Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework. Terrestrial restoration is about halfway to that 30 per cent target, but freshwater, marine and coastal work remains far behind.

Money is the clearest barrier. Annual restoration funding must rise more than fourfold, from about 64 billion dollars today to roughly 296 billion. If that gap is closed, restoration could create up to 32 million jobs by 2030. Restoring just 15 per cent of global priority areas could prevent 60 per cent of projected species extinctions and sequester about 30 per cent of carbon dioxide–equivalent emissions — gains that help both biodiversity and the climate.

Talks in Yerevan finished early on Saturday morning with a new action plan, yet finance stayed the sticking point. Countries appear on track for only one of the 24 Global Biodiversity Framework targets. More than one billion dollars was pledged at the meeting, about half from philanthropists including the group Re:wild, but that sum is small beside the yearly need.

FAO Director-General Qu Dongyu stressed that "restoration works" when communities and science work together. CBD Executive Secretary Astrid Schomaker warned that people cannot fix nature with one hand while destroying it with the other: stopping habitat loss must go hand in hand with rebuilding damaged lands and waters.

For IELTS learners, this story links environment, jobs and public finance — three frequent exam themes. Notice how the text moves from concrete progress to a funding gap, then to policy talks and a clear warning. That achievement–challenge–call-to-action pattern often appears in Reading passages and Writing Task 2 essays on climate and nature.
paragraphs_zh: 联合国「生态系统恢复十年」过半之际，一份新的全球报告带来少见的好消息：约2.52亿公顷、分布在149个国家的土地正在恢复——面积大致相当于哈萨克斯坦。这项努力已创造逾一百万个绿色就业岗位。联合国环境规划署执行主任英格·安德森表示，世界正在见证有记录以来规模最大的自然运动之一的雏形。
题为《自然的回归——为人类与地球扩大生态系统恢复》的报告在亚美尼亚埃里温举行的生物多样性缔约方大会第十七次会议（COP17）上发布。各国仍致力于到2030年恢复约十亿公顷，并按照2022年《昆明—蒙特利尔全球生物多样性框架》的约定，将百分之三十的生态系统置于保护之下。陆地恢复大约已达到该百分之三十目标的一半，但淡水、海洋与海岸方面的工作仍远远落后。
资金是最明显的障碍。每年的恢复资金必须增加逾四倍，从目前约640亿美元增至约2960亿美元。如果这一缺口得以填补，到2030年恢复工作最多可创造3200万个就业岗位。仅恢复全球优先区域的百分之十五，就有望避免百分之六十的预计物种灭绝，并封存约百分之三十的二氧化碳当量排放——这对生物多样性和气候都有帮助。
埃里温的会谈在周六清晨提前结束，并达成一项新的行动计划，但资金仍是症结所在。各国似乎仅有望实现《全球生物多样性框架》24项目标中的一项。会议上承诺提供逾十亿美元，其中约一半来自包括Re:wild在内的慈善方，但相对于每年的需求，这笔数目仍然很小。
联合国粮农组织总干事屈冬玉强调，当社区与科学携手时，「恢复是有效的」。《生物多样性公约》执行秘书阿斯特丽德·肖马克警告说，人们不能一只手修复自然、另一只手又在摧毁它：制止栖息地丧失，必须与重建受损的土地和水域同步推进。
对雅思学习者来说，这篇报道把环境、就业与公共财政这三个常见考试话题联系在一起。注意文章如何从具体进展讲到资金缺口，再到政策会谈与明确警告。这种「成果—挑战—行动号召」的展开方式，在气候与自然类阅读篇章和写作任务二中经常出现。
